components.name: Variant disclosure
components.description: Prepared colour materials, expandable without hiding save/publication semantics.
components.html:
Білий · матеріали відтінку

Фото полотна без ручки та прив’язка до каталогу.
components.css: .ds-variant { border-top: 1px solid #d9dde3; padding: 24px 0; font-family: Overpass,sans-serif; color: #30343b; } .ds-variant summary { cursor: pointer; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-variant[open] summary { margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-variant summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #315ca4; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Labelled field
components.description: Incumbent field with explicit label and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font: 600 14px/1.5 Overpass,sans-serif; color: #30343b; } .ds-field input { display: block; margin-top: 6px; padding: .375rem .75rem; font: 400 14px/1.5 Overpass,sans-serif; color: #30343b; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: .25rem; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #a8a8a8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .2rem rgba(105,105,105,.25); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #315ca4; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Existing operational admin, not a new visual identity. Reuse its shell, Bootstrap forms, typography and dark action buttons.
dos: Do preserve readable explicit labels and the existing admin language.
donts: Don't present unsaved controls as the published version.
